data.investment_objective: To generate long-term capital appreciation by predominantly investing in equity and equity related instruments selected based on a quantitative model. However there can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the scheme would be achieved.
data.asset_allocation:
Equity and equity related instruments based on quant model 80% - 100% 
Other Equity and Equity related instruments 0% - 20% 
Debt and Money market instruments 0% - 20%
Units of Mutual Fund Schemes (including ETFs) 0 - 20% 
Units issued by InvITs 0% - 10%
data.exit_load:
• 1% of applicable Net Asset Value - If the amount sought to be redeemed or switch out is invested for a period of up to three months from 
the date of allotment
• Nil - If the amount sought to be redeemed or switch out is invested for a period of more than three months from the date of allotment
The Trustees shall have a right to prescribe or modify the exit load
structure with prospective effect subject to a maximum prescribed
under the Regulations.
